title: Siman 408
section: Fleeing from Philosophical Inquiry and Strengthening in Faith

segments.he: שָׁמַעְתִּימֵאֶחָד שֶׁשָּׁמַע מֵרַבֵּנוּ זִכְרוֹנוֹ לִבְרָכָה שֶׁסִּפֵּר לוֹ מֵעצֶם הַקְּדֻשָּׁה שֶׁלּוֹ בְּיַלְדוּתוֹ, שֶׁבִּהְיוֹתוֹ יֶלֶד
segments.en:
(2.) And he greatly mocked what is written there about those who say — regarding the giving of the Torah — that G-d forbid Moses our teacher, upon him be peace, used his wisdom to devise schemes etc. And it is forbidden to repeat such words even in jest, G-d save us. May G-d save us from such corrupt alien ideas! Woe to whoever has even one such thought enter him. And one need not refute such foolishness.

And it is already explained in several books...
